about_the_game:
Four centuries ago, the world witnessed the Decline of the Gods — the end of an age where divine forces walked among mortals. At the heart of this cataclysm a creature forged in the depths of primordial Chaos: Draltaksan, an ancient dragon born from absolute darkness.

Forged at the dawn of the world, Draltaksan belongs to the oldest of the three tyrant races: the dragons — beings born of Chaos, in contrast to humans, shaped between light and shadow, and elves, born from pure light. His rise marked the collapse of harmony among peoples and the fall of the deities that once protected the balance of the world.

Through an unprecedented sacrifice, the threat was contained — but never destroyed.

Now, in a new era of apparent prosperity, the world begins to crack once more. Forgotten signs return. Whispers echo through ancient ruins. Silent cults invoke names long erased from the memory of mankind.

Amid this rising tide of darkness, a young man marked by the past is summoned to the royal capital of Aetheria. His calling is not merely the beginning of a journey, but the rise of a fragile hope in the face of the first shadows threatening to descend upon the world.

In this demo you can play with the following characters:

Oleg – Rogue

A shadow warrior marked by the scars of his past. A survivor of a tragedy that devastated his homeland, Oleg is summoned to the heart of Aetheria to answer a higher calling. Quiet yet resolute, he carries in his eyes the promise of vengeance.

Alexander – Paladin

Captain of the northern infantry and member of the sacred Order of Paladins of Aetheria. Alexander embodies honor, loyalty, and unwavering faith in the ideals of the kingdom. A defender of balance and justice, he leads with sword in hand and a pure heart.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mild 2D violence. Combat generally does not feature realistic blood or gore. Some abilities feature stylized visual effects with a dark aesthetic, but these do not directly represent blood.
The narrative addresses themes such as crime, political corruption, and murder, with soldiers' bodies visible in the environment, but without graphic representation.
The language includes occasional profanity and aggressive expressions between characters (e.g., "bastard," "damn you," "I'm going to kill you").
The game does not contain nudity or sexual content.
Specific scenes and some enemies may feature more direct use of blood, especially in fantasy or supernatural contexts, but without extreme realism or explicit gore.

name: Heart of Gaia Demo
short_description: Lead the resistance against an ancient, dark order seeking to awaken an ancient evil and plunge Gaia into chaos. Explore a vast, Steampunk-themed fantasy world and face formidable adversaries in this action RPG featuring real-time character switching and dynamic combat.
